newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent dull and soft, awaiting more Iraq news.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent dull and soft, awaiting more Iraq news.

text.p: SIMEX Brent futures were quiet and expected to be slightly softer on Friday as brokers waited for news of further developments in the Gulf.
The United States and Iraq appeared on Thursday to back away from further confrontation despite conflicting claims of continued Iraqi troop movements against Kurdish rebels, brokers said.

"We have to see if there would be further provocation from Saddam Hussein and how the U.S. reacts to it," one broker said. "But at the moment the market is in the doldrums. The market has reached the top and is now easing off."
October was quoted at $22.10/$22.20, straddling the previous close on London's IPE at $22.16. November was indicated at $21.40/$21.65, within IPE'S settlement range of $21.50.
Trading on the ACCESS after-hours system firmed marginally to the day's high of $23.45 for October, one cent over its NYMEX close in New York.
